"""Compressed-scale behaviour: logical sizes far beyond materialisable limits."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
from main import run
from modules.byte_program import hash_bytes, MAX

MASK = (1 << 64) - 1


def geometric(power, count):
    total = 0
    for _ in [0]:
        pass
    # sum(power**i for i in range(count)) mod 2**64 via doubling
    def go(k):
        if k == 0:
            return 0, 1
        if k == 1:
            return 1, power
        half, pw = go(k // 2)
        total = (half * (1 + pw)) & MASK
        full = (pw * pw) & MASK
        if k % 2:
            total = (total + full) & MASK
            full = (full * power) & MASK
        return total, full
    return go(count)[0]


def doc(definitions, cases=(), events=(), channels=(), timeout=10):
    return {'seed': 's', 'definitions': [list(row) for row in definitions],
            'timeout_ms': timeout, 'cases': list(cases), 'events': list(events),
            'channels': list(channels)}


def case(name, frames, method='GET', target='/a', host='h'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames,
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}


failures = 0


def check(name, got, want):
    global failures
    if got != want:
        failures += 1
        print('FAIL', name)
        print('  got ', str(got)[:400])
        print('  want', str(want)[:400])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


# 1. multi-gigabyte Content-Length body, hashed lazily
body_len = 2_000_000_000
request_head = b'POST /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n' % body_len
prefix_len = len(request_head)
document = doc([['BODY', 'b"x" * %d' % body_len],
                ['HEAD', json.dumps(request_head.decode('ascii')).encode('ascii').decode()[1:-1].join(['b"', '"'])]],
               channels=[{'name': 'edge', 'parts': [
                   {'case': None, 'data': '{{HEAD}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': '{{BODY}x}' if False else '{{BODY}}'}]}])
start = time.time()
out = run(document)
elapsed = time.time() - start
record = out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
body_hash = (257 * 0 + 121 * geometric(257, body_len)) & MASK  # ('x'+1) = 121
check('huge length body (%.2fs)' % elapsed,
      (out['channels'][0]['error'], record['framing'], record['body']['n'], record['body']['h']),
      (None, 'length', body_len, '%016x' % body_hash))
check('huge channel bytes n', out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n'], prefix_len + body_len)
check('committed', out['channels'][0]['committed'], [0, 1])
check('start/end', (record['start'], record['end']), (0, prefix_len + body_len))

# 2. huge chunked body: 3 copies of a 500 000 000 byte chunk then zero chunk
chunk = 500_000_000
head = b'POST /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n'
document = doc([['CH', 'b"y" * %d' % chunk],
                ['HDR', 'b"%s"' % head.decode('ascii').replace('\r', '\\r').replace('\n', '\\n')]],
               channels=[{'name': 'edge', 'parts': [
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '{{HDR}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': '7a963400\r\n'},
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '{{CH}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': '\r\n'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': '{{CH}}'},
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '\r\n0\r\nX: y\r\n\r\n'}]}])
start = time.time()
out = run(document)
elapsed = time.time() - start
record = out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
yhash = (122 * geometric(257, chunk)) & MASK
full = chunk * 3
digest = 0
for _ in range(3):
    digest = (digest * pow(257, chunk, 1 << 64) + yhash) & MASK
check('huge chunked body (%.2fs)' % elapsed,
      (record['framing'], record['body']['n'], record['body']['h'], record['trailers']['n']),
      ('chunked', full, '%016x' % digest, 8 + 20))
check('chunked owners', record['owners'],
      [['copper', len(head) + 10], [None, chunk + 2], ['copper', 2 * chunk + 2 + 10]])
check('chunked flags', record['flags'], ['identity', 'mixed_owner'])
check('chunked error', out['channels'][0]['error'], None)

# 3. huge line without LF is a syntax error, quickly
document = doc([['NOISE', 'b"z" * %d' % (10 ** 12)]],
               channels=[{'name': 'edge', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': '{{NOISE}}'}]}])
start = time.time()
out = run(document)
check('huge unterminated line (%.2fs)' % (time.time() - start),
      (out['channels'][0]['error'], out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n']),
      ({'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, 10 ** 12))

# 4. exact line limit: 8192 bytes of content then CRLF is fine, 8193 is syntax
for extra, kind in ((0, None), (1, 'syntax')):
    line = b'A' * (8192 + extra)
    document = doc([['L', 'b"\\x41" * %d' % (8192 + extra)]],
                   channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': '{{L}}'},
                                                     {'case': None, 'data': '\r\nGET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'}]}])
    out = run(document)
    check('line limit %d' % (8192 + extra),
          out['channels'][0]['error'],
          None if kind is None else {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0})

# 5. receipt with a huge datagram
document = doc([['G', 'b"q" * %d' % (3 * 10 ** 9)]],
               cases=[case('copper', [{'Type': 'datagram', 'data_to_transfered': '{{G}}'}])])
out = run(document)
row = out['cases'][0]
qh = (114 * geometric(257, 3 * 10 ** 9)) & MASK
tail = b'\x00'
value = (8 + 4 + 1)  # head
head_hash = hash_bytes(b'\x00' * 7 + b'\x01' + b'\x00\x00\x00\x00' + b'G')
length = 8 + 3 * 10 ** 9
combined = (head_hash * pow(257, length + 1, 1 << 64)
            + (8).to_bytes(8, 'big') and 0)
check('huge datagram receipt', (row['payload_bytes'], row['sent']['n'], row['frames'],
                               row['request_frames'], row['state']),
      (3 * 10 ** 9, 8 + 4 + 1 + 8 + 3 * 10 ** 9 + 1, 1, 0, 'timeout'))

# 6. repeat that exceeds the logical limit is rejected
document = doc([['X', 'b"ab" * %d' % ((MAX // 2) + 1)]], cases=[])
check('oversized repeat', run(document), {'error': 'input'})
document = doc([['X', 'b"ab" * %d' % (MAX // 2)]],
               channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': '{{X}}'}]}])
out = run(document)
check('max size accepted', out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n'], (MAX // 2) * 2)
check('max size error', out['channels'][0]['error'], {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0})

print('big: %d failures' % failures)
sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
PYEOF
